refnamediv.refpurpose: Checks the conformance of EPUB files

refsection.title: Introduction
refsection.para: This step uses the W3C EPUBCheck validator to check the conformance of EPUB files.

para.error: It is a dynamic error if the assert-valid option on ex:epubcheck is true and the EPUB document is not valid.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The cx:epubcheck is the same as the ex:epubcheck step with the exception of the error code raised when assert-valid is true and the EPUB is invalid.
